I will not put chemical fertilizer on this bean plot because beans usually manage with little or none, and I have to watch my costs carefully. I will use my own local seed and some manure or compost if I can gather enough, because that is cheaper for me. I do not expect to irrigate, and I am unlikely to use chemicals for pests unless there is a serious problem. Most of the work will be done by my household, with only a few hired days if we fall behind.
